action_items: Provide/refresh valid talent test credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md - both alexandra@test.com and kushi.kudgunti@test.com are returning 401. Without valid talent login, EventsSection on talent dashboard cannot be runtime-verified.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx PayPal QR uses `paypal.me/${email.split('@')[0]}` which only works if the PayPal username matches the email local-part - misleading for admins. Consider a separate 'PayPal.me Username' field instead of deriving from email.
UPI QR string hardcodes payee name to 'BFM' (pn=BFM) - consider making this configurable or using the payment_note as payee name.
AdminDashboard.jsx is now 3102 lines - should be split into feature modules (PaymentSettings, EventsPayments, QRSharing) for maintainability (>700 line rule).
paymentQRSettings state (line 67) is not persisted to backend - values are lost on page refresh. Should be saved via API if admins want to reuse without re-entering.
